verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a native Shares feature. Owners can grant read access to specific users, roles or accounts in the organization, limit exposed tables with include patterns, and share publicly with any MotherDuck account in the same cloud region. Consumers attach a share URL (md:_share/...) directly rather than receiving an export. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that shares are zero-copy and stay live/updated, cross-organization sharing beyond public same-region shares (no private targeting of a specific external org), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
